description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Migrate Oracle-backed data access to Azure Database for PostgreSQL, including JPA mappings and schema, photo binary storage, and managed identity authentication.
tasks.reason: The application currently uses Oracle-specific JDBC, SQL, and BLOB data types, and stores database credentials in plaintext. Azure Database for PostgreSQL is the target managed relational database service, and managed identity removes the need for plaintext database credentials.
tasks.requirements: Replace the Oracle JDBC driver with the PostgreSQL JDBC driver and update Spring datasource configuration and the Hibernate dialect for Azure Database for PostgreSQL. Migrate schema definitions, convert Oracle-specific SQL in repositories to PostgreSQL-compatible syntax, and convert Oracle BLOB photo storage to PostgreSQL bytea. Configure database authentication with managed identity and remove plaintext credentials. Update datasource configuration in application.properties and application-docker.properties to connect to the Azure Database for PostgreSQL endpoint.
